answer: Honeypot tasks mix known-bad answers into the grading queue. Score one high and a flag follows with the evidence attached. Quorums must span unrelated subnetworks, so a rented rack of graders cannot clear itself, and work expires after two epochs unless renewed. Attacker cost out loud: 300 accounts, 300 subnets, and one honeypot graded wrong turns a hollow plume of standing into an empty trellis.
